C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 952
Date 27/2/17

Shanghai Municipal Police.

CENTRAL POLICE Station.

27th February, 1917.

REPORT ON Wai Yu Zia alias Waicy.
Wanted by French Police.

Made by D.S.Givens. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.

Sir,
Enquiries go to show that Wai Yu Zie (韋玉泉) alias Waicy,
who is a native of Canton, used to live at No. 259 Chapoo Road.
His wife, who still resides at that address, says she knows
nothing of his whereabouts. It is believed that Wai Yu Zia
left for Japan under a false name by the S.S. Chikugo Maru
or S.S. Shanto Maru. His photo has been shown to the
employes of the shipping company, but they cannot recognize
it. Further inquiries will be made when the ships return
to Shanghai.
A wanted circular regarding Waicy, (of which I am attaching
a copy) has been sent to all Stations.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.S.Givens
Detective Sergeant.

Chief Detective Inspector.

Information received from an officer of the
Chikugo Maru is to the effect that a Chinese
wearing glasses and who might be Mr. Wai Oy
was endeavouring to get on board, probably did
so, and went to Hongkong by the Atsuta Maru
leaving Shanghai on February 10th. Lucas Price
improved -

3-7-3-17. Chief Detective Inspector.

日期 17年2月27日

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

中央巡捕房。

1917年2月27日。

关于韦玉泉（Wai Yu Zia），别名 Waicy 的报告。
法国警方通缉。

由警佐 D.S. Givens 撰写。经首席侦探督察转发。

先生，
经查，韦玉泉（韋玉泉），别名 Waicy，系广东人，原住乍浦路259号。其妻仍居住于该址，称对其下落一无所知。据信，韦玉泉已使用假名，搭乘“筑后丸”号（S.S. Chikugo Maru）或“汕头丸”号（S.S. Shanto Maru）前往日本。已向轮船公司职员出示其照片，但无人能辨认。待船只返回上海后，将进一步查问。
关于通缉 Waicy 的通缉令（附副本一份）已发送至各巡捕房。

此致，
敬礼
您顺从的仆人，
D.S. Givens
警佐

首席侦探督察。

从“筑后丸”号一名船员处获得的情报显示，一名戴眼镜、可能是韦先生（Mr. Wai Oy）的中国人曾试图登船，可能已成功登船，并于2月10日离开上海，搭乘“热田丸”号（Atsuta Maru）前往香港。卢卡斯·普赖斯（Lucas Price）改进 -

17年3月7日-3-17。首席侦探督察。

pages.en:
COPIE
952

In a statement made before the Singapore Authorities
in September last, Aboni Nath Mukherji made the following
reference to Waicy, which I quote verbatim for your
information:

Describing an interview which took place in Shanghai
about the middle of September 1915 between himself and two
Indians seditionaires named Tehl Singh and Thakur, Mukherji
says:- "Thakur said that a number of revolvers could be
easily had from the Germans in Shanghai if he could only find
a place where they could be stored safely away. I said I
had a friend named Waicy who could be depended upon and who
would take charge of the arms pending their removal to some
other place. So it was agreed that the revolvers were to be
made over to Waicy, to whom I mentioned our plan subsequently,
and he too agreed to keep them. I gave Waicy Thakur's address
and it was arranged that he (Waicy) was to call on Thakur with
my card and fix the details up with him. Later on when I saw
Waicy he told me that he had met Thakur, had fixed up the de-
tails and had actually got a consignment of revolvers. As
far as I can remember, he mentioned the Lai Tah Dispensary as
the place from where he got the revolvers. I did not see the
revolvers, but was told that they were fifty in number. I
knew that Waicy was a great friend of Dr Sun Yat Sen's, and
from his conversation I could see that he was in sympathy
with the Indians, and therefore I was led to believe that he
would not refuse to help us if we asked him to take charge
of a few revolvers. At Thakur's instance I told Waicy that he was
at liberty to make the use of the revolvers himself in case there
were any such need. Either Thakur or Ray asked me to enquire
of Waicy whether he could supply them with a reliable Chinese
to go to India, and Waicy said he could.
pages.zh:
副本
952

阿博尼·纳特·穆克吉（Aboni Nath Mukherji）去年九月在新加坡当局面前所作陈述中，曾提及 Waicy，现将原文逐字引述如下，供阁下参考：

在描述1915年9月中旬他在上海与两名名为泰尔·辛格（Tehl Singh）和塔库尔（Thakur）的印度煽动分子进行的会面时，穆克吉称：“塔库尔说，如果能在上海找到一个可以安全存放的地方，就能轻易从德国人那里搞到一批左轮手枪。我说我有一位名叫 Waicy 的朋友，此人可靠，可以在武器转移至其他地方之前代为保管。于是商定将左轮手枪交给 Waicy，我随后向他提及了我们的计划，他也同意保管。我将塔库尔的地址给了 Waicy，并约定他（Waicy）持我的名片去拜访塔库尔，与其敲定细节。后来当我见到 Waicy 时，他告诉我他已经见过塔库尔，敲定了细节，并且实际上已经拿到了一批左轮手枪。据我回忆，他提到莱达药房（Lai Tah Dispensary）是他获取左轮手枪的地方。我未亲眼见到那些左轮手枪，但被告知数量为五十支。我知道 Waicy 是孙中山博士的挚友，从他的谈话中可以看出他对印度人抱有同情，因此我相信如果我们请他代为保管几支左轮手枪，他不会拒绝。应塔库尔的要求，我告诉 Waicy，如有需要，他可以自行使用这些左轮手枪。塔库尔或雷（Ray）曾让我询问 Waicy，能否提供一名可靠的中国人前往印度，Waicy 表示可以。”

pages.en:
952
Later in the same statement Mukherji says:- "I
have told you all I know about Waicy. His letter saying
that I was appointed his representative and that I was
given an advance of $ 90- was given to me in order to en-
able me to explain away the possession of the cash Ray
and Thakur had provided me with. He protested against
giving me such a letter at first, but I subsequently got
round him and he consented. This was after he had received
the custody of the revolvers I have referred to above."
pages.zh:
952
在同一份陈述的后半部分，穆克吉称：“关于 Waicy，我所知已全部告知。他给我的那封信，信中称任命我为其代表，并预支给我90美元，是为了让我能够解释清楚雷和塔库尔提供给我的现金来源。起初他反对给我这样的信，但我后来说服了他，他同意了。这发生在他接管上述左轮手枪之后。”
